equations.name: Canonical execution order of one timestep (pipeline rule)
equations.latex: \text{errors} \to z \to \Pi \to \text{gains} \to S^{inst} \to \theta_{eff} \to B_t(S_t) \to B(t) \to \theta \text{ step} \to r \to \text{reset} \to \text{leak} \to \text{statistics}
equations.locator: Math Spec v1.2 draft §13 Table 3; SSOT §8 (15 steps) and its prohibited shortcuts

claims.order: The ignition decision at t compares S(t) (errors up to t − 1) with θ_eff(t); then the allostatic step with δ_reset·B(t), the exact decay and the floor; then r(t); then the retention; then the leak with S_inst(t); then the statistics with ε(t). Changing the order changes results at identical parameters.
